name: Da Nang resort living
summary: My Khe beach towers, Non Nuoc sand, and Son Tra peninsula resorts when the sea is the trip.
body: Sleep on the sand when morning swims matter. Son Tra and Non Nuoc carry the peninsula and Marble Mountain views. My Khe is the city beach row.
These properties are named only from their operator sites. A beach day in Hoi An is still a ride away.

properties.name: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort
properties.summary: Private bay on Son Tra Peninsula, reached from the city by car.

properties.name: Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa
properties.summary: Non Nuoc beach between the Marble Mountains and the East Sea.

properties.name: Pullman Danang Beach Resort
properties.summary: Vo Nguyen Giap beachfront facing My Khe and the resort line.
